# Muzezuru

> A Shona-speaking conversational AI, fine-tuned on BLOOMZ-3B via QLoRA. Free, open source, built as a zero-budget research project to bring a low-resource language (Shona, Zimbabwe) to a working chat model.

Muzezuru is a full-stack AI project: a fine-tuned language model hosted on Hugging Face, a live chat demo, and this web frontend. It is not affiliated with any company; it's an independent research/portfolio project.

## Key facts

- Base model: bigscience/bloomz-3b, fine-tuned with QLoRA (4-bit quantization + LoRA adapters).
- Trained on Shona instruction/response data, cleaned of a discovered data-contamination issue (documented in the GitHub repo).
- Known limitations: strongest on conceptual/philosophical Shona prompts, weaker on factual/geographic accuracy and precise instruction-following.
- Hosted on Hugging Face Spaces (free ZeroGPU tier); this site is a custom frontend calling that Space directly.

## Links

- Model + adapter: https://huggingface.co/denzelchingodza/muzezuru
- Live demo (Gradio): https://huggingface.co/spaces/denzelchingodza/muzezuru
- Source code: https://github.com/denzelchingodza/muzezuru
